name: clean-explainer
label: Clean explainer (Ali Abdaal-style)
description: Calm curious talking head, kinetic text beside the speaker with yellow keywords, framework cards per point, paper transitions, low lo-fi bed.

sync.broll: screen recordings, book covers, simple diagrams on each named concept or number; ~65:35; mostly PiP beside the speaker, full-frame diagrams 2-4 s
sync.fillers: text card per framework point, push-in on the key line, paper transition between sections (every 30-60 s)
sync.music: one low lo-fi bed, ducked hard (-22..-24 dB), stops for emphasis lines; no beat-cutting
sync.emotion_map: curiosity → clarity → relatability → empowerment (music lifts slightly)
sync.transitions: hard cuts in sections, paper fold/tear between sections

compliance_lock: health: factual benefits only, no 'best/guaranteed', no patient quotes
